text_block_list.text:
Agnes Digital's Senior Year Spring G1 
campaign has concluded. And then—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
How was it, Trainer? What do you think of 
Digi-tan's results this spring?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
You don't often see someone run this 
consistently, do you~? Well, what do you 
think? Poke, poke~.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Aahn, what a lovely sound as always~♪ 
Well, I did work hard enough to deserve 
such praise, after all.

These results are certainly commendable. 
And what's more—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The time has come. My Battle of 
Sekigahara. My Hulao Pass. The doujin 
convention itself. In other words...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The time for the decisive battle is here!! 
The time to challenge both Opera O-san and 
Doto-san to a final showdown!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, so much has happened 
to bring us to this point...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Tussling and tangling with all kinds of 
Umamusume on both turf and dirt...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I didn't have any single standout 
strength. But my ability to click with 
anyone, anywhere was truly extraordinary!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"And every step we take is setting the 
stage! It's all foreshadowing, you see!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Combining the experience I've gathered on 
both turf and dirt... I'll beat the two I 
admire so much!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"And on top of that, I'll show off how 
amazing horse girls are by really pushing 
it front and center with my own running!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"This is the grand finale of Project 
Digi-tan! Now Trainer, where shall our 
autumn showdown take place?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
A true hero doesn't choose their 
battlefield, but today is an exception, 
yes indeed...
The two of us began the screening process.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
First, dirt is out of the question. Even 
if I'm good at it, neither of you two are.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"I guess miles are out for the next one 
too…… I'm fine with shorter distances, but 
those two are suited for medium to long 
distances after all."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: If so, the most suitable would be—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Say whaaat!? Trainer, say that one more 
time!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Right there--!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"...I had a feeling you'd say that. Asking 
again was just for the bit."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Tokyo Racecourse, 2000m on turf. There's 
no better race to bring out the best in 
both Opera O-san and Doto-san!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Let's go right there. There, Digi-tan will 
become an oshi! Not just a star!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Huh, what is it, DESU?
choice_data_list:
I feel like we're at a serious 
disadvantage, though...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ugh, that's...

Tokyo Turf 2000m is the quintessential 
middle distance. Which means it'll be a 
pure, unadulterated contest of skill.

Tricks won't work. We have to defeat the 
dominant duo, TM Opera O and Meisho Doto, 
through sheer ability...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"You're quite right... But there's no 
helping it. It's just my nature."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"I want to see the horse girls run their 
best in the place where they can shine the 
brightest!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"I don't want to win by dragging them into 
my own swamp. If it comes to that, I'd 
rather not run at all."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Shine on, Umamusume-chan! And shine even 
brighter than that, me!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
This is what cool really means! And this 
is what being a fan is all about, I think.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Sooo... you'll indulge me, won't you? 
Just this once, with my selfish request."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's the spirit, Comrade!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Well, I always believed in you, though. 
Ehehe...

This too is my destiny as a born 
oshi-fangirl. Agnes Digital has no 
hesitation.

The extraordinary all-rounder enters the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn). This news swept 
through Tracen Academy.
